text:
maria: Heads up — I'm starting the secret ownership migration for payments svc. Goal: split the service account used by projected token mounts into per-namespace SAs and annotate ExternalSecrets with redwood.com/owner so we can safely transfer ownership. PR: https://github.com/redwood/prod-infra/pull/4123 — needs quick review + staging smoke test.

aj: pinged. Quick question: are we changing key names inside the K8s Secret or just annotations/SA? Will this touch TF state for kubernetes_service_account resources?

maria: Only annotations and ExternalSecret mapping; TF will create new kubernetes_service_account resources (svcacct-per-ns) and keep the old SA until cutover. Snippet:

```
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "payments_sa" {
  metadata {
    name = "payments-svcacct"
    namespace = var.namespace
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/owner" = var.owner
    }
  }
}
```

samir: FYI I hit a race where projected tokens were created before the RoleBinding existed — pods failed for ~30s. Suggest adding a pre-rollout job to ensure RoleBinding exists and retry with backoff. Also add an owner label to secrets for safe GC.

lee: Test plan:
1) apply TF in staging
2) deploy ExternalSecret with `refreshInterval: 1m`
3) watch pods `kubectl get pods -w -n payments`
4) `kubectl exec` into a pod to validate creds

I can run Friday morning. @maria can you add RBAC check step to the PR?

infra-bot: CI status: pre-merge checks passed for prod-infra#4123 — terraform fmt/validate ok. plan shows creation of 2 service_accounts and 1 rolebinding.

maria: Added `scripts/check-rbac.sh` to PR — waits for rolebinding with 120s timeout. Also added `redwood.com/owner` as a label on ExternalSecret. PTAL @aj @lee

aj: Nit: keep `redwood.com/owner` as both annotation + label? Some tooling reads labels only. Labels make GC easier.

samir: Agree. Also recommend ExternalSecret `policy: Replace` during migration so secret content doesn't drift.

ops-oncall: Rotation window: avoid 01:00-03:00 UTC (backup/rotation jobs). Schedule outside that. Rollback plan: retain old SA for 24h, revert TF if issues.

lee: :thumbsup: I'll run Friday 15:00 UTC staging. @maria set PR to draft until staging smoke passes.

maria: Thanks — updating PR now with label + pre-rollout job. Will ping when staging pass completes.
